title: Inflatable travel pillow
text: Inflatable travel pillow. I bought this to use as a back rest when I am at a hotel and reading in bed... so slightly off use of actual purpose, but still reasonable I think.  First time I blew it up, it deflated almost immediately and I was disappointed... I was thinking it had a leak... However, I think it was actually that I had not properly closed the valve and then leaned on it just right, slowly deflating it.  I re-inflated it, pressed the valve tightly and turned the pillow so I wasn't pressing directly on the valve - no leaking.  The valve sticks out and doesn't pop into the pillow.. The outside is "flocked" material... soft... doesn't have a strong plastic odor.... When I went to deflate it... it was fairly easy to do and took a few minutes.  It did take a bit of work to get it deflated and back in the little carry case - more time than I would like.  I actually quit trying to put it back in the bag and just roll it up now.  All in all, I am happy with it.  It doesn't take up huge amounts of room and is quick to inflate.  I will update my review should new info seem useful.
